infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Market Mapper uses your location to capture businesses, places and market paths.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Market Mapper can continue an active path recording when background field mapping is enabled.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Market Mapper to use your location while mapping markets.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Market Mapper to continue recording an active market path when background location is enabled.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Market Mapper to select a field photo for a mapped business.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Market Mapper to take field photos for mapped businesses.
